item.title: Drain completely blocked with soft soggy clay, 21st August
item.description:
This drain was already blocked with silt, the small lake caused by a heavy shower yesterday has slowly drained, but has now left behind an additional pile of soft soggy clay which has washed down in the steady stream of water from a mains leak further up St Mary's Avenue. Any significant rainfall will just recreate the small lake as it will have nowhere to drain away. Please clear this drain. Perhaps someone could m make a site visit to assess the problem?

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cumberland Road, Shortlands, Greater London

item.title: Fly tipping the entire length of the footpath, 21st August
item.description:
Literally the entire length of the footpath from just outside 56 Wellan close all the way to where the footpath reaches Westwood Lane is being used as a fly tipping area. In some cases it’s litter, plastic bottles, glass bottles, which given the current fire risk due to the weather has to be a real issue. Other parts of the footpath has building materials, mattresses, very large black bags and it is only getting worse. I have attached two photos to show the extent of the problem. I could have attached more.
